t2.thesis: CBRS reports into a heavily de-rated AI tape with a ~14% implied move, high short interest and beaten-down positioning, but prior prints fell on beats, so the setup is balanced and I stay near the base rate.
reasons: Stock is down about 67% from its 52w high and about 32% over 1m, with analysts still bullish (rec 1.27) and Wedbush expecting a beat and raise (I16); low expectations and 20% short interest favor a squeeze on good news.
Both prior prints were negative on the open-to-open measure (-11.6%, -2.7%) despite large EPS beats; the stock sells off on beats, and valuation is rich (P/S 35).
Implied move of about 14% and IV at 2.3x realized vol make the outcome close to a coin flip with a fat-tailed distribution; no skew or call/put signal (IV spread about 0, put/call volume about 1.04).
Macro is a headwind: hot inflation, talk of rate hikes and an AI-infrastructure selloff (I7, I18, I21); the entry-day open is also taken before the print, so the 11/12 move itself is not captured.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 guidance and 2027 outlook versus the elevated bar, especially the revenue conversion of the $25.4B RPO, gross margin and OpenAI concentration, as read against the AI-infrastructure sentiment.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542 and AMC session 0.538; hardware_networking cluster 0.586 is the closest cluster, but small differences are only candidates, so I stayed near the overall rate.

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The date you mention (2026-11-12) is after today's date (2026-11-11) and beyond my knowledge, so I have no information on how CBRS's stock moved after that earnings report.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 4 points from 0.54 to 0.50: the weak post-earnings history and the risk-off AI/rate backdrop roughly offset the washed-out positioning and short-squeeze potential.

theses.expected: Rise: beat and raise with RPO conversion and capacity updates trigger a squeeze in a washed-out, heavily shorted name.
theses.mechanism: Low expectations after a 60%+ drawdown, 20% short interest and a bullish analyst base make good news produce an outsized rebound.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is merely in line, or margins and cash burn disappoint, and the stock sells the news as it did in August.

theses.expected: Fall: sell the news despite an EPS beat, as in the last two prints.
theses.mechanism: Rich valuation, GAAP losses, warrant dilution and customer concentration, plus a hostile macro backdrop, limit the upside from a beat.
theses.wrong_if: The company raises 2027 guidance sharply and announces new large customers, so the stock gaps up.

theses.expected: Roughly flat: a large implied move but a muddled print leaves the open-to-open change small.
theses.mechanism: Mixed signals, with strong cloud growth offset by margin pressure and pass-through revenue noise, so macro and the AI tape dominate.
theses.wrong_if: Revenue or guidance is clearly far above or below consensus, producing a gap of 10% or more.

key_observations: Q4 core revenue guide and the 2027 'more than triple' commentary
Core and GAAP gross margin trajectory and operating loss
RPO growth and its conversion schedule (OpenAI MRA, AWS lease commencement)
Data center capacity and financing, working capital loan and warrant dilution
Customer concentration and any new contract announcements
Tone of the AI-infrastructure sector on the day
